name: expense-webapp
description: Single-page browser app for employees (my claims, claim editor), managers (team queue, decisions) and finance (approved list, export batches, reporting lines with a manager picker over every recorded employee). Calls GET /me at startup so each person is recorded on first open. One bundle, one distinct user-facing surface. Holds no business data or secrets; calls expense-api with the signed-in user's token.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: All claim, approval, export and reporting-line operations, plus GET /me at startup.
